name: System Lab tokens
description: Combines reference, semantic and component token sets with three modifiers: theme (light/dark), product (System Lab, Harbor, Meadow) and density (comfortable/compact). Read by scripts/tokens/build-tokens.mjs.

reference.description: Raw scales and palettes. Never consumed directly by components.

semantic.description: Theme-independent roles: focus geometry, control sizing, layout rhythm, typography.

component.description: A few deliberate component extension points that alias semantic roles.

theme.description: Color theme. Both contexts must define the same semantic color roles, including every product's brand roles.

product.description: Product brand and shape. Contexts only re-point existing roles, so every product inherits everything it does not override.

density.description: Spacing and control size. Independent of theme and product.
